limitations: The quality matrix proves the report on the three hosted runners, not reference Obsidian reopen behavior, disk-full, ACL/permission-loss, cloud-placeholder or power-loss behavior.

The desktop matrix validates packaging and attribution only; it does not certify signing, publication, same-user OS isolation, human accessibility or release readiness. The selected /home/ashutosh/Obsidian vault was not accessed or modified.
result: The host round-trip implementation and its three-runner quality evidence are green; the transient macOS packaging download failure was cleared by one unchanged retry, and the final desktop matrix is green.
